scope: 12 frozen conversation families; exact literal user statements and speaker-aware exclusions
pass1: Inspect source user turns, select exact evidence, preserve native pointer, hash, speaker, timestamp and statement kind.
pass2: Check interpretation and delimit scope, uncertainty and relations. Both passes are assistant work in the same session; no independent adjudication or owner approval.
quotation_rule: A user message containing a quoted external text does not make every embedded statement a user preference. Record external quotation exclusions. Do not claim semantic reading of an entire excluded quoted work.
coverage_rule: Record every user node and source-message hash in the review inventory; nonuser text is surrounding context and never a declared user preference. A review is not a recall guarantee or independent semantic gold.
temporal_rule: Use native timestamp and ancestry. Array position alone does not establish chronology, supersession or active branch. Exact prior statements remain preserved.
application_rule: Annotations are historical scoped evidence for retrospective source inspection. They do not establish current preferences or permission to act, and do not change the selected profile engine.
view_rule: Inject only evidence whose source node is in the actual context view. Annotated relations to hidden evidence do not disclose its contents or establish an answer from omitted material.
absence_rule: A completed hash-bound review may yield an empty known-evidence set. This is not a claim that no preference exists. Uncertain candidates keep their individual reasons.
unresolved_rule: No semantic inference, second extraction call, owner endorsement or independent judgement may be replaced by a placeholder.
preparation_rule: Materialize only changed source_explicit arms and reference already prepared none/selected_profile arms unchanged from the previous release.
